name: You Can Bank on Batman
description: Build the grapple point, then grapple up and press the lever to open the gate. Drop down and recieve minikit.
Grapple back up to the ledge, then climb up the ladder to recieve minikit.

Turn on V-sync for lag. Precisely batarang clip through dumpster against alley wall to get into corner of building. Rapidly jump out through wall to get behind the glass, bypassing sonic suit to receive minikit.

Place a bomb in the alley. Jump onto the dumpsters, then batarang the bomb. Jump and catch the batarang mid-air to get a batarang double jump up onto the catwalk, bypassing he need for a strong character to lift the dumpsters. Blow up the window to recieve minikit.

Jump on hood of truck. Inch over to the pieces in the toxic waste and building the front bit by bit. When the truck is complete, place Robin in front of the door and ram into him, pushing him through to bypass the Riddler door and receive minikit.

Batarang clip against the left wall of the alley on top of the glass containers to clip through. Get pushed into the wall, then fall down to the right and land on copy of magnet wall under the level. Stand on the left side near the back edge and batarang to warp up on top of the real magnet wall while staying clipped inside the buildings. Run and double jump to the right, then fall forward and right to land behind the grate, bypassing strong man. Walk to end of tunnel to get onto balcony and recieve canister.

Jump in the red cars and drive down through the toxic waste to the garage doors. Place a bomb by the far right door, then run to the left just at the edge of the toxic waste. Turn on Ice Rink cheat to make floor slippery. Batarang the bomb, then time a jump into the toxic waste by the edge of the garage door so that when you die, you grab the batarang. This activates ghost hearts, making you invincible and clipping the player through the garage door and bypass the Riddler doorto recieve minikit.
Destroy 5 telephone booths throughout the level to recieve minikit.
Destroy the window and kill the henchman to recieve hostage.
Destroy the lockers in the vault to recieve red brick.

name: Green Fingers
description: Place the giant plant right in front of the gate scene transition. Stand between the flower beds near the canal to set a safe position across from the minikit. Double jump into the water, then ride the swan boat back to the left of the room. Jump out onto the shore between the poles to maintain previous safe position. Get close enough to the gate to jump into the giant plant. Immediately drop out while getting into the plant to pass through the scene transition, then drop back in to prevent jumping off the plant. Walk the plant over to the left pillar, then jump out to land on the pillar. Position player 2 across from player 1 near the water. Start running against the invisible wall as player 1 and drop out to get the player stuck trying to run towards player 2. Pause buffer and watch for the super jump to activate. When player 1 jumps, switch players immediately to pass above the fountain, bypassing the dive suit and sonic suit to recieve minikit.

As Poison Ivy, stand on the edge of the 4th step, then jump and cling against the invisible wall opposite the pipe. Continue to wall jump up until landing on the edge of the top of the pipe. Jump off and through the left wall to get stuck behind the hot pipe and die. The player will respawn back on the pipe. Immediately double jump around the hot pipe to land out of bounds behind the warp pipe exit. Turn off V-Sync to allow for infinite wall jumps. Begin wall jumping up the invisible walls, which extend infinitely high. Continue wall jumping around 220 times or for about 3 minutes. Ponder what the hell you are doing with you life. Once the wall jumping is complete, let go of the wall and fall down, first briefly going towards camera to move away from other invisible walls jutting out, the continue to the right. Aim the camera down as you fall to anticipate where you might land. As you approach the bottom, make quick adjustments to try and center the player in the middle of the chamber. With luck, the player will land directly over the button, and the force of the fall will push the player through the water to depress it and drain the chamber. Walk into the second chamber and refill the water to bypass the sonic suit and dive suit and recieve minikit.

As Poison Ivy, stand against the invisible wall on the left side right before the steps to set a safe position. Double jump around and to the left to land against the corner of the room. Switch to the Riddler and punch Poison Ivy into the corner to get her stuck. Pause buffer and watch for the super jump, then switch back to Poison Ivy. When the player is positioned Just over the last rung of the railing, tab off the game to create lag, then tab back in and run towards the bottom left, causing the player to clip out of bounds past the invisible walls. Stand against the thin pillar on the left wall and jump up to land on a pixel perfect edge of the pillar. Double jump to the right and forward to just get over and past the scene transition. Go against the wall where the collision ends, then jump around and behind it. Angle back in towards the wall to just land for a frame on the edge of the floor without clipping back in bounds, then immediately double jump and continue forwards. Fall until you land in a sliver of water that extends past the wall. Carefully swim forward to about midway down the length of the pool, then double jump to the left to clip into the adjacent room. Kill the henchmen to bypass the demolition suit and recieve hostage.
